intent: At 3.4fps, an unrepaired mid-frame loss requests one key frame 580-620 ms after the revealing packet (gap NACK round trip is read-driven, so the bound depends on fps), not at the 2 s expiry. The expiry's own report coalesces into it. RED when the early gap request is removed (first request at ~2 s) or fires before its NACK window.
